rationale: Record that gating a Chrome-for-Testing extraction unit test to macOS crosses the chromium-authoring-frontend selector through experimental/pulp-rs/src/cmd/chrome_for_testing.rs. Only the test's cfg attribute changes (it needs bsdtar to read a ZIP, which GNU tar on Linux cannot); the browser download, extraction and install code, the pinned browser, and every other test are unchanged. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture behaviour, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
